description: Source code implementing PoolAllocator and Allocation classes for memory pooling, including methods for allocation, deallocation, guard block checking, and management of memory pages.

classes.name: PoolAllocator
classes.description: Memory pool allocator managing fixed-size memory blocks with support for push/pop state management.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents individual memory allocations within the pool, with guard block checking.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size from the pool, handling page management and alignment.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::pop
methods.description: Deallocates all allocations made since the last push, returning pages to free list.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::push
methods.description: Saves current allocation state for potential later pop.

methods.name: Allocation::checkGuardBlock
methods.description: Checks guard block memory for corruption.
